items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: I have played approximately 3 or 4 concerts for him and he's a good guy to play for.

ctx.x: And I have a fish song that it ever got to Sesame Street or somewhere like that it would go over. It's called 'I don't care how fast a fish may swim that he'll never sweat.' I recorded it in Paris, but it didn't mean anything over there. I never recorded it here but I do it a lot. I did it on a Jack Kleinsinger concert and we had 700 people sing it -- audience participation. 700 people sang 'He'll never sweat.' It goes over good...
Cats & the Fiddle -- had they been looking for an electric guitar player
